title: Courage and Boldness
definition: Courage and Boldness is Spirit-empowered faithfulness to speak, obey, endure, and stand for Christ without fear of people.
summary: Believers can be bold because Christ is Lord and the Spirit gives strength.
christFocus: Jesus Christ reigns with all authority and gives His witnesses courage to confess Him before the world.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Courage and Boldness describes a Spirit-formed pattern of life for those who belong to Jesus Christ. Christian living is not an attempt to earn salvation but the grateful response of people who have been saved by grace and called to walk with the Lord.

Scripture presents this truth so believers can grow in holiness, endurance, love, wisdom, worship, and mission. It touches the heart, the mind, the tongue, relationships, daily habits, and faithful obedience in ordinary life.

The emphasis of this doctrine is believers can be bold because christ is lord and the spirit gives strength.. It points disciples away from self-reliance and toward abiding dependence on Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because discipleship can become shallow when it is reduced to information, emotion, or outward activity alone. Courage and Boldness teaches believers how grace becomes visible in daily conduct, perseverance, relationships, and obedience to Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask the Lord to form this truth in you through Scripture, prayer, repentance, and faithful practice. Let courage and boldness shape how you think, speak, serve, endure, forgive, and represent Christ in the places God has assigned to you.
